decisions.reason: Manual prize redemption occurs after winner selection and does not change the Chainlink VRF provider, on-chain selection, fairness, verification surface, or applicable draw.

The source concerns redemption of a prize and does not change NFT-holder eligibility, Lit Protocol gating, ownership checks, or the Datil network.
The source changes the prize-claim flow only; coded-referral commissions remain automatic and are independently governed.
The current landing-page state describes prize frequency, referral entries, selection, and promotional layout but does not specify automatic prize payout or a claim interaction.
Prize redemption does not change the royalty amount, enforcement standard, marketplace policy, pool funding, or ticket treatment of secondary royalties.
The source does not change which book rights, referral identity, badges, or active and expired prize tickets follow an NFT after transfer.
